about: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is the largest single coal-producing company in India, accounting for 21.00% of domestic coal production in Fiscal 2026. A Miniratna Category I subsidiary of Coal India Limited, it operates 17 mines across the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields in Odisha. Its business is predominantly focused on the extraction and supply of thermal-grade non-coking coal to the power and industrial sectors.

promoters.background: Coal India Limited is a central public sector undertaking and the world's largest coal producer, operating via multiple subsidiaries across India.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 55.94% of revenue from operations in FY26, and thermal power utilities accounted for 68.62% of product sales.

litigation_note: Total contingent liabilities represented 39.80% of net worth as of March 31, 2026 (55.86% as of September 30, 2026), pending adjudication before various forums.
strengths: India's largest single coal producer, accounting for 21.00% of national coal production in Fiscal 2026.
Audited JORC coal reserves of 9,840.31 MT sustain production for around 45 years at current output levels.
Strategic backing and extensive resource support from parent company Coal India Limited, the world's largest coal producer.
Highly mechanised opencast mining operations with 99.37% of coal extracted using cost-efficient surface miners in FY26.
Integrated coal evacuation infrastructure featuring rail connectivity across three zones and access to five maritime ports.
Rail-led first-mile connectivity accounted for 96.86% of FMC dispatches and 65.28% of total coal dispatch in FY26.
Strong profitability profile with an EBITDA margin of 47.45% and RoNW of 53.77% in Fiscal 2026.
Robust demand support through long-term Fuel Supply Agreements with key state and central power generation utilities.

risks.title: Product Concentration Risk
risks.detail: Raw non-coking coal accounted for 97.41% of sale of products in Fiscal 2026 and 97.38% in the six months ended September 30, 2026.

risks.title: Thermal Power Sector Dependence
risks.detail: Sales to the thermal power sector represented 68.62% of product sales in Fiscal 2026 and 69.64% in the six months ended September 30, 2026.

risks.title: High Customer Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers generated 55.94% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026 and 51.95% in the six months ended September 30, 2026.

risks.title: Substantial Contingent Liabilities
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities not provided for stood at 39.80% of net worth as of March 31, 2026 and 55.86% as of September 30, 2026.

risks.title: Government Entity Credit Risk
risks.detail: Government-owned utilities contributed 44.81% of revenue from operations in FY26 and 41.68% in H1 FY27, increasing exposure to delayed receivables.

risks.title: Reliance on Third-Party Contractors
risks.detail: Top 10 contractors accounted for 60.02% of contractual expenses in Fiscal 2026 and 63.61% in the six months ended September 30, 2026.

risks.title: Growth in Trade Receivables
risks.detail: Trade receivables rose 73.30% from March 31, 2024 to March 31, 2026, while operational revenue decreased by 3.43% across the same timeframe.

risks.title: Pending Groundwater NOC Renewals
risks.detail: No-objection certificates for groundwater dewatering from the Central Ground Water Authority remain pending renewal for 12 operational mines.

notes: Restated consolidated financial statements used. Stub periods for six months ended September 30, 2025 and September 30, 2026 are excluded from period arrays. Paid-up shares were sub-divided from ₹1,000 to ₹2 face value in August 2026; share counts and EPS are restated accordingly. Cash and bank includes other bank balances.
